47:     matrix, counts = m.parent.metrics.group_metrics(labels, logits)
48:     queries = query_metrics(labels, logits)
49:     if (matrix.shape != (len(labels), 22) or queries.shape != (len(labels), 28, 10)
50:             or not np.allclose(matrix[:, 12:], queries.mean(1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)
51:             or any(v["tp"]+v["fn"] != 20 or v["tn"]+v["fp"] != 358 for v in counts)):
52:         raise ValueError("Full metric/query/confusion correspondence differs")

54:     nullable = matrix.astype(object)

49: def save_array(path: Path, values: np.ndarray, root: Path) -> dict:
50:     if path.exists():
51:         raise FileExistsError(path)
52:     np.save(path, values, allow_pickle=False)
53:     if not np.array_equal(np.load(path, allow_pickle=False), values):
54:         raise ValueError("Array roundtrip changed values")
55:     return data.record(path, root)

I03: actual caps
scripts/step28_continual_five_run.py : 80-92
源SHA256=d1b8eca42d5fc8fb62612f46a4b69375b9f273b83acd2fed74e0b6b00eda4cdc
80:     def check(self, reserve: int = 0) -> None:
81:         now = time.monotonic()
82:         if now >= self.deadline-self.tail:
83:             raise TimeoutError("Allocated task allowance reached; termination tail reserved")
84:         if reserve or now-self.last_checked >= 5:
85:             self.last_checked = now
86:             rss = resident_bytes(owned_processes(os.getpid()))
87:             used = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in self.root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink())
88:             self.peak_rss, self.peak_disk = max(self.peak_rss, rss), max(self.peak_disk, used)
89:             if rss > 64*2**30 or used+reserve > 224*2**30:
90:                 raise RuntimeError("Approved worker RSS or campaign storage cap exceeded")
91:             if shutil.disk_usage(self.root).free < reserve+64*2**30:
92:                 raise RuntimeError("System disk safety margin unavailable")
